title: microflow/1
description: The canonical stored text of a report spec's micro-flow (report-spec pipeline model §7a 'Representation', §10.1). Stored as JSON text in Egeria's ReportSpec.microflow property. A bare JSON list of stages is the legacy format 0 and is converted on read. pyegeria.view.microflow.MicroflowV1 is the parser; this schema documents it. A format-only spec (no action; owner decision S2-1) has "stages": [], no params and at least one formatter.

params.description: Spec-level parameters, by name. A stage binds one as "$name".

stages.description: The micro-flow. Empty only for a format-only spec, which then declares no params and at least one formatter.

stage.description: producer/find or producer/analytic in stage 1; other kinds are valid but not run yet.

type.description: The open metadata type a find stage looks for.

function.description: producer/find: Class.method on an EgeriaTech client class, on pyegeria's find-method allowlist (FIND_METHOD_ALLOWLIST). producer/analytic: a registered analytic name. Never a dotted module path.

params.description: Argument bindings: "$name" names a spec parameter, anything else is a constant.

out.description: The shape the stage produces (recorded, not checked, in stage 1).

additional_props.description: producer/find only: a client function the formatter calls per element for extra properties (FormatSet.get_additional_props). Only a name on pyegeria's ADDITIONAL_PROPS_HOOKS.

formatters.description: One formatter per output format (DICT, TABLE, REPORT, MERMAID, ALL, ...).

oneOf.description: a field key; its label comes from the shape (stage 1: the column catalog)

related_label.description: Column.label: the name a related element shows in text outputs; 'label' is the column's title

document.description: A DOCUMENT formatter's document block (SD-1): standard, media_type, file_name, validator, validator_options.

same_as.description: An output format written earlier in formatters whose formatter this one shares (a Format with several types). It carries no columns or field of its own.
